analyst_view.overall: Iberia 1999 (29th of 36, 1 point) host Getafe (30th, 1 point) in Tbilisi; Iberia lean on striker Amiran Dzagania and a fairly settled side, while Getafe probably need wins here and at home to Inter Escaldes to reach the top 24. Getafe have lost three in a row without scoring, including 3-0 to Atlético on Sunday, sit just above the LaLiga drop zone and go to Espanyol on Monday; Bordalás has put the league first and they rotate heavily (about 44% of the eleven kept over six games). The match-day team-news page lists Boselli, Juanmi and Uche (counted) plus defender Romero and Drammeh as unavailable; Carvajal is now in the numbers' missing list, while earlier reports had Carvajal and wing-back Andrés García missing from the travelling group; Mayoral, Satriano, Ünal, Azón and Djené are in the UEFA squad list. Romanian referee Horațiu Feșnic is named and already counted.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.7 goals, 1.7 for Getafe. Getafe have not scored in three games, Bordalás has openly put the league first with a must-win trip to Espanyol on Monday, and Andrés García and Romero are missing too, none of which the numbers see; I go to about 2.6.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.4 corners, 5.0 for Getafe, and already cut Iberia for winning only 4 in their last three. A rotated Getafe side still plays direct with crosses into the box, so the count should hold; I stay at 8.4.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.9 cards, already high because Getafe foul a lot, Iberia have picked up many cards lately and referee Horațiu Feșnic has shown 5.5 a game in his two on record. Djené, sent off against Atlético, is free to play here, but that is Getafe's normal profile, so I stay at 5.9.

shots.text: The numbers say 24.7 shots, nearly 16 for Getafe, and already lift Getafe for their recent shot volume. A rotated Getafe side with league priorities and a blunt attack lately should be cautious, so I trim to about 23.7.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.1 shots on target. With Getafe likely to rest starters before Espanyol and without a goal in three games, and Juanmi and Uche out (already counted), I go a little lower, to about 7.8.
